messages:
maria-partnerships: quick sync — ACME ModelHub asked if we can co-host their ‘Orchid-13B’ weights and also enable a mirrored downloadable artifact with geo-blocking (US only for export). They want a joint announcement end of month and a marketplace SKU. Need legal + eng signoff on licensing, export controls, and KMS requirements. link: https://acme.example/models/orchid-13b
kevin-legal: high level: co-hosting + mirror ok in principle but must have a distro addendum and supplier attestation. export controls: 13B likely low-risk but we need supplier export classification + an OED-style questionnaire. do we have provenance on training data?
eli-engineering: we can support both hosting and mirror. Mirror requires signed redistribution agreement and a checksum endpoint we can verify. Hosting requires packaging quantized artifacts and an alias for fallback. Also need to confirm caching/kv handshake for prefix cache across mirrored requests.
sam-platform: ops notes: for co-hosting with downloadable weights we’ll need a restricted bucket (geo restriction + signed URL) and KMS integration if customers bring keys. marketplace SKU flow requires INF ticket + billing SKU mapping.
kevin-legal: action items from legal side: 1) distro addendum (redistribution + attribution + liability cap) 2) supplier export-control classification 3) dual-use risk assessment 4) embargo and embargo-lift process. i can draft the addendum but need ACME to complete the export questionnaire.
maria-partnerships: timeline proposal: draft addendum by Fri, supplier returns questionnaire next Wed, sign & infra work week after, announcement target 2 weeks post-sign. ACME requested joint blog + console badge + coordinated press window (48h).
eli-engineering: implementation notes for infra: mirroring approach = hourly signed tarball from ACME -> our staging bucket, run checksum verification, then rsync to public mirror. hosted fallback mapping: 
```
alias "orchid-13b": {
  "hosted": "orchid-13b-redwood-v1",
  "mirror_url": "https://mirror.redwood.example/models/orchid-13b.tar.gz",
  "checksum_url": "https://mirror.redwood.example/models/orchid-13b.sha256"
}
```
we'll also need an alias mapping in model-catalog and a canary rollout to ensure performance parity.
ops-bot: reminder: new marketplace/cohost listings require INF-7890 (infra ticket) and security review by sec-team.
kevin-legal: @maria-partnerships please add ACME's legal contact and provenance docs. i'll run a quick risk check and send a prelim addendum. :thumbsup:
maria-partnerships: added ACME contact laura@acme.example and uploaded provenance bundle to /shared/partnerships/acme-orchid. copying @sam-platform for bucket/KMS constraints. i'll assemble a single checklist doc and ping when draft addendum out.
